documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in construction services. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing user in the construction services industry who is experiencing workflow issues after a configuration change. They have explicitly stated that this is a support incident and that support should be involved before any discussion of expansion. The operational friction is described as 'workflow stopped after a configuration change.'

claims.quote: Please get support involved before discussing expansion.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. It sounds like your workflow has been impacted by a recent configuration change. As you've indicated, this is a support incident, and we recommend engaging with our support team to resolve the current issue before any further discussions about expansion. Our support team is equipped to assist with troubleshooting and ensuring your workflows are restored efficiently.
questions: What specific configuration change caused the workflow to stop?
Have you already contacted the support team for assistance?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the configuration change is not specified.
